claims: Jon Scheyer is the head coach of the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer took over from Mike Krzyzewski in the 2022-2023 season.
Jon Scheyer is a former Duke All-American player.
Jon Scheyer was a long-time assistant under Mike Krzyzewski.
Jon Scheyer has won an ACC title.
Jon Scheyer reached 100 wins faster than any coach in ACC history.
Jon Scheyer secured a top-seeded NCAA tournament team within his first four years.
Jon Scheyer's contract is extended through the 2028-29 season.
Mike Krzyzewski retired in 2022 after 42 seasons.
Mike Krzyzewski was the previous coach of the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team.
The 2025-26 season marks Jon Scheyer's fourth year as head coach.
